categories.welcome: Welcome to the world of Casa Natura

mission.title: Our mission
mission.subtitle: Nature's purity, in your home
mission.description: In 1994, in the province of Lodi, our soap factory was born with a clear mission: to create high-quality soaps using selected ingredients and traditional methods. We have become a reference point in the national natural cosmetics landscape, supplying stores throughout Italy. Our commitment to craftsmanship and sustainability guides us in choosing excellent raw materials, ensuring effective products while respecting the environment. Today, we continue to write our story with passion, bringing the scent and purity of our soaps to every corner of the country. Welcome to the delta green world, where tradition and innovation meet.
